def transform(grid):
    # Find separator row
    separator_row = None
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(c != 0 for c in row):
            separator_row = i
            break
    
    # Find top segment row (first non-zero row after any zeros)
    top_row = None
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if any(c != 0 for c in row):
            top_row = i
            break
    
    # Find bottom segment row (last non-zero row before separator)
    bottom_row = None

        if any(c != 0 for c in grid[i]):
            bottom_row = i

def transform(grid):

    bottom_row = None
    for i in range(len(grid) - 1, separator_row, -1):
        if any(c != 0 for c in grid[i]):
            bottom_row = i
            break
    
    if top_row is None or bottom_row is None:
